record.question: There are ways through which a community can support a school. Which of the following is not included?
options: Sharing natural resources of the community for school
Organization of community functions in school buildings or compopund
Sharing of expertise by local artisans, artists, carpenters, blacksmiths, iron smiths, painters etc
Employment of local resource persons for organizing programmes
record.explanation: Organizing community functions in school buildings is a use of the school by the community, not a way the community supports the school.
